head_sha_semantics: the commit that carries the deliverables this manifest describes (script + two evidence tables + this handoff). A commit cannot contain its own SHA, so that commit recorded PUSH_PENDING and the source SHA here as a placeholder; this follow-up commit is the one that names it. The remote tip is read back with git ls-remote, not trusted from the push output, and is recorded in remote_readback below.
followup_commits_note: this file was updated by one further commit on the same branch, whose own SHA is only readable from outside it (git log or git ls-remote). It changes nothing but head_sha, push_status, the remote read-back and the source-divergence record.
